about: The one list of report statuses (总表 P19 ③, 2026-11-04 问题普查 checker_input_rejected 29 条: the receiver refused 'Invalid report status' because the prompt that produced the report never named the allowed values). Producers (check_guard.not_run, runtime_regression, check_package, grok-image-review's prompt) and receivers (check_package.regression_record, grok-image-review parse_report) read this file through check_guard.status_values(); none of them writes its own list.

meaning.passed: 检查真的跑了，至少查了 1 项，全部通过
meaning.not_run: 未执行：检查要的输入缺失或为空（写明缺什么），或实际检查 0 项；不算通过
meaning.not_applicable: 包里没有这项功能（例如没有激励广告），这项检查不适用；写明原因
meaning.environment_incomplete: 环境不完整：没有浏览器、包缺触摸件、ZIP 没有出包回执；不算通过

package_cli.about: R4H 批 (Round4 #21): the top-level status of the check_package.py command line. An official run has no status field (read verdict); these two are the only top-level values. Not check values: a regression record or report using them is still refused.

meaning.unofficial_not_deliverable: 只读预检，不可交付：ZIP 不是正式出包入口写的（没有对得上的出包回执）；不算通过
meaning.refuse: 检查没法做：输入不是可读的 ZIP 或目录、文件坏了；写明原因，不算通过

runtime_requirement.about: R4H 批: status of one row of check_package result.runtime_requirements (for example webp_decode_capability).

meaning.requires_runtime_evidence: 静态检查管不了这一项，要真机或运行时证据（cases 写了要跑哪些）；不算通过也不算失败

tool_identity.about: R4H 批: status of check_package result.tool_identity (tool_identity.py) and of tools_in_use().

meaning.clean: 用的检查工具和 Skill 发版记录一致
meaning.modified: 用的是改过的工具：只警告，写反馈草稿，不拒绝
meaning.dev_tree: 在开发树里跑，不和安装版对照
meaning.unknown: 找不到发版记录，没法对照
meaning.error: 对照工具本身出错（写在 error）；只报告，不影响结论

meaning.issue: 有要报告的问题（写在 issues）
meaning.uncertain: 看不清或要人判断（写在 uncertainties）
